note: Ceilings for the authored cascade, measured by scripts/design-metrics.mjs and enforced by scripts/check-design-budget.mjs. Lower a ceiling whenever its measure falls; raise one only with a stated reason in the same reviewed change.

reasons.stylesheetsLinked: One above the pre-token baseline of 57: design-tokens.css is the token sheet itself.
reasons.cssBytes: Above the pre-token baseline of 671727: a token reference is longer than the literal it replaces. Removing provably dead declarations recovered part of it; it falls further as override layers are retired.
reasons.rootHasSelectors: Three remain from before this ratchet (PDF reader, launcher background, mobile reader); none may be added.
reasons.colorLiterals: Counts two held stylesheets that keep literal values: mobile-shell.css (reference-exact, owned by the mobile tasks) and sign-in.css (the sign-in page migrates under its own review).
reasons.htmlBytes: Above the pre-token baseline of 131970 by the token stylesheet link and one class on the Reader empty state, which lets it share the empty-state rule without an id raising that rule's specificity.
reasons.declarations: Raised by 2 from 20160: the item card icon was drawn 18px in a 12px box and overlapped its title on main; its size is now set in the rule that owns the card header.

interaction.note: Mean wall time of one surface switch including forced style and layout, from scripts/review-switch-cost.mjs --budget. One 60 Hz frame is 16.7 ms.

rendered.note: How layered the rendered interface is, from scripts/review-cascade-depth.mjs --budget: declarations that match a visible element and lose to another, at longhand level, across the 13 surfaces at 1180x740. Main at cbb8e9f measured 71976. scripts/review-primitives.mjs --strict separately requires that no stylesheet but the theme decides a property a primitive owns.

The composer hides its own text while the syntax overlay draws it.
